name: Hotel kitchenette finder
pitch: Find a hotel with a kitchenette so you can store baby food.
instructions: Start by searching for hotels with kitchenettes in the city you are visiting. When results appear, open a few listings and check the room description for the words "kitchenette" or "kitchen". If a listing mentions a kitchenette, note the hotel name, address and price. If no listing mentions a kitchenette, open the map view and look for hotels that advertise in-room kitchens or kitchen facilities. When you cannot find any hotel with a kitchenette, say so and offer to search for hotels with a fridge instead. End by showing the person the hotel names and prices you found, or a note that nothing matched.
starters: find a hotel with a kitchenette
look for hotels with a kitchenette

examples.ask: find me a hotel with a kitchenette in london
examples.does: search the web for hotels with kitchenettes in london and list the ones that mention a kitchenette in the description

readme:
# hotel kitchenette finder
Find a hotel with a kitchenette so you can store baby food.

It needs web_search and browser_navigate. It will not book anything or share your data.
